faqs.question: Do you offer cash on delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer Cash on Delivery (COD) across all cities in Pakistan.

faqs.question: Can I visit your store?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our store is located in Lahore, Pakistan. Visit us Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM.

faqs.question: Do you offer installation services?
faqs.answer: Yes, free installation is available for Ceiling Fans within Lahore. For other cities, installation charges may apply.

faqs.question: How can I track my order?
faqs.answer: Once your order is dispatched, you will receive a tracking number via SMS and email.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD), bank transfer, JazzCash, and EasyPaisa.
